title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for protecting the organization's information systems and digital assets by developing, implementing, and maintaining technical security controls. This role includes conducting security assessments, monitoring systems for vulnerabilities or intrusions, and ensuring that the organization's IT environment remains compliant with industry and regulatory standards such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. The engineer also plays a critical role in incident detection, response, and prevention.
Supervisory Authority
NONE
Nature And Scope
Operating in a dynamic threat landscape, the Cybersecurity Engineer reports to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity and works with other IT, compliance, and business stakeholders. Although not a supervisory role, the Cybersecurity Engineer may guide junior staff or external contractors and lead technical implementation efforts on security-related projects. The role demands staying up to date on emerging threats, tools, and best practices, and proactively evolving the organization's defenses accordingly.
This position is both hands-on and strategic, requiring expertise in secure system design, threat intelligence, monitoring tools, and risk mitigation. It encompasses environments spanning on-premises data centers, hybrid infrastructures, and public clouds (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Principal Accountabilities
Conduct vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security configuration reviews.
Evaluate system and application hardening measures using CIS benchmarks and STIGs.
Monitor networks and endpoints using tools like SIEM, EDR, and IDS/IPS (e.g., CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
Analyze security events and logs to detect, triage, and respond to threats.
Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools, including:
Firewalls
Network Access Control (NAC)
Antivirus/Endpoint Protection
DLP, CASB, and vulnerability management platforms
Develop and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and operating procedures.
Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external frameworks such as NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI DSS.
Develop and deliver training on phishing, password hygiene, and secure computing practices.
Support tabletop exercises and simulation drills to test security readiness.
Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security into system architecture.
Participate in project reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the system development lifecycle.
Core Competencies
Experience in the following:
Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RAIDUS\NPS, CAs
Bare metal servers and data center configurations
Falcon Crowdstrike
Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
Hybrid cloud integrations
Authentication protocols
Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE
Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations
Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security
Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management
Deep understanding of encryption, PKI, authentication, secure networking, and operating system security across Linux and Windows environments.
Proficient in analyzing logs, threat intelligence, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) to drive timely threat mitigation.
Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Methodical and responsive approach to detecting, responding to, and remediating security incidents.
Works cross-functionally with IT, audit, compliance, and legal to promote enterprise-wide security awareness and enforcement.
Careful review of systems, code, and configurations to identify small changes that may indicate large risks.
Able to shift priorities rapidly in response to new vulnerabilities, threat campaigns, or business requirements.
Minimum Requirements
A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in computer science/ Information Technology with a security concentration. A master's degree in business administration is highly desirable. Must have 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a security engineering role. One or more industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer Associate is required or strongly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate hands-on expertise in network and application security architecture, cloud security controls across platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP, identity and access management (including IAM, SSO, and MFA), and security monitoring tools such as SIEM, SOAR, and EDR. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and secure DevSecOps practices is essential. A solid understanding of key regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements—including GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA, and FISMA—is also required. In addition to technical capabilities, the candidate should possess strong collaboration and critical thinking skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

THE CENTER FOR CAREER & PROFESSIONAL SUCCESS
The Center for Career and Professional Success (CCPS) is a unit within the Office of Undergraduate Studies (OUS). CCPS' goal is to become a standard-bearer for providing innovative and transformative career development opportunities for students and alumni.
THE OFFICE OF UNDERGRADUATE STUDIES
The Office of Undergraduate Studies (OUS), an established unit within the Office of the Provost, operates with goals to meet and exceed retention, persistence, graduation, career, and post-graduate outcomes. OUS comprises three major units: The Academic Center for Excellence, the Center for Career & Professional Success, and the Office of General Education. Collectively, OUS units provide transformative offerings through three major functions: academic excellence support, academic and career exploration, and career development.
Basic Function
Provide career coaching, guide self-discovery through workshops and experiential learning opportunities, and assist students and recent alumni with resume, interview, job/internship search, and overall career preparation.
Nature And Scope
Reporting to the Director, Center for Career and Professional Success, the Career Coach serves as a key supporter in the vocational journey of students and recent alumni. Provides advice and coaching as well as facilitating experiential learning opportunities, supports job and internship search, and champions overall career development. Must also have effective interpersonal skills, including verbal and written communications, training abilities, and customer service skills and experience.

Provide individual and group career coaching to undergraduate students and new alumni related to major and career exploration, internship and job search, professional development, graduate school planning, employer and alumni engagement.
Conduct resume/cover letter critiques and job-search strategies and provide guidance regarding application procedures.
Coach and advise students on available tools, resources, services, and employment platforms.
Create and facilitate engaging and informative workshops, events, and programs.
Administer and interpret career assessment instruments (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator, Strengths, Focus 2).
Provide liaison and consultative services to departments, faculty, staff, specific student populations, and student organizations.
Maintain case notes that track client progress, assessment results, and counseling goals.
May teach Career Development courses.
Engage and maintain relationships with employers to aid in student recruitment and professional development activities.
Assist in the management of the VMock platform, including troubleshooting, training staff/students, and tracking data.
Assist in the management and updating of data for the Handshake platform.
Collaborate with other departments/student services to effectively market internship, full-time, and experiential learning opportunities through outreach and programming.
Provide input into program administration, implementation, and social media presence to engage students.
Participate in staff activities/meetings, annual performance evaluations, and professional development activities, including involvement in regional and national associations.
May supervise undergraduate student workers.
Lead/coordinate special projects or initiatives as assigned.
Represent Career and Professional Success at campus/community functions.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Excellent customer service orientation
Knowledge of career development and student development theories, research, practices, and recruiting trends
Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and time management skills
Proven presentation, group facilitation, and teaching skills
Innovation and creativity in program development
Extensive ability to collaborate and develop relationships with a wide range of constituents
Supervision and leadership skills
Outcomes assessment, learning outcomes, and evaluation strategies
Outstanding teamwork abilities and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and employers
Development of metrics and methods for continuous improvement of processes, goals, and strategies
Proficiency with and disposition to learn general and industry-specific software such as Handshake, VMock, and Microsoft Office products
MBTI and/or Strength's certification preferred
Ability to work some evening or weekend hours
Thorough understanding of the benefits of workplace diversity and the career-related developmental needs of Black and underrepresented populations.

Bachelor's degree. Motivated/enthusiastic work style, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a broad range of students and alumni.

Sobre a vaga

Sobre a Allianz
Somos a Allianz Seguros, a seguradora nº 1 do mundo, com mais de 120 anos de história no Brasil. Temos uma sólida presença no mercado brasileiro, oferecemos soluções inovadoras e confiáveis em seguros e somos comprometidos com a excelência no atendimento e na proteção de nossos clientes.

Procuramos talentos inovadores e apaixonados por desafios, que queiram fazer parte de uma equipe de alta performance, que valoriza a colaboração e coloca o cliente no centro. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade para transformar sonhos em realidade, e queremos que você faça parte dessa jornada conosco.

Sabemos que, juntos, a gente faz acontecer, e é o propósito de proteger o futuro de nossos clientes, parceiros e comunidades que apoiamos que nos impulsiona a superar desafios e celebrar conquistas. Projetos

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis para squads já existentes, garantindo alinhamento, colaboração e foco na entrega de valor.
  • Trabalhar como interface estratégica entre áreas clientes e áreas de suporte (TI, Marketing, Financeiro, Operações, Jurídico e demais stakeholders).
  • Garantir que os projetos estejam alinhados às prioridades estratégicas da Allianz e ao roadmap corporativo.
  • Estimular ideações, identificação de oportunidades e iniciativas que contribuam para acelerar resultados do Programa de Aceleração.
  • Liderar a governança do portfólio de projetos da área, garantindo comunicação clara, priorização e alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Experiência com facilitação de workshops de ideação, design thinking e inovação.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta complexidade e ritmo acelerado, conduzindo múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados, BI ou automação (Power BI, Tableau, IA aplicada, automações com CoPilot, etc.).

title: Jovem Aprendiz
description:
Descrição da vaga
Na Inbrands, acreditamos no poder da formação e do protagonismo jovem para transformar o presente e construir o futuro. Estamos em busca de um(a) Jovem Aprendiz curioso(a), comprometido(a) e com vontade de aprender, que queira iniciar sua trajetória profissional em um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e criativo. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de conhecer de perto o funcionamento de grandes marcas de moda, desenvolvendo habilidades técnicas e comportamentais ao lado de profissionais experientes.
Somos líderes e agimos como donos. Temos um imenso orgulho de tudo o que fazemos e um enorme prazer em cada realização. Executamos de forma simples, onde sempre prevalece o melhor argumento e a melhor ideia na gestão de moda.
Em nosso portfólio estão Bobstore, Ellus, Richards, Salinas, VR Collezioni e Tommy Hilfiger. Nossas marcas são consideradas icônicas e estão posicionadas como marcas premium com distribuição através de lojas próprias, franquias, multimarcas e e-commerce.
Se você gosta de moda, de um ambiente descontraído, dinâmico e cheio de desafios vem para Inbrands
Lembramos que nossas oportunidades são para todos. Na Inbrands, você encontra um ambiente diverso, com respeito e empatia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar rotinas administrativas da área em que estiver alocado (como RH, LOGISTICA E FABRICA.).
Organizar documentos, arquivar materiais físicos ou digitais e atualizar planilhas ou sistemas internos.
Ajudar no controle de agendas, atendimento telefônico e suporte a demandas internas.
Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão de materiais simples, como apresentações, relatórios ou comunicações.
Apoiar a equipe em atividades operacionais do dia a dia.
Participar de treinamentos oferecidos pela empresa e/ou instituição parceira.
Cumprir com o cronograma de aprendizagem (teórico e prático), conforme o programa
Requisitos e qualificações
Cursando Ensino Médio ou Superior;
Fácil acesso a Rua São Miguel 11 disponibilidade para jornada de 6 horas por dia
Ter entre 16 a 18 anos;
Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
Proatividade
Conhecimentos básicos em informática (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Noções básicas de atendimento, administração ou área de interesse
Informações adicionais
Horário (Entrada 8h As 12h e 13h as 17h );
Assistência médica com contratação de dependentes;
Assistência Odontológica;
Seguro de vida 100% custeado pela empresa, afinal valorizamos a segurança;
Flexibilidade para você escolher entre vale refeição ou vale alimentação;
Para quem gosta de trazer a sua refeição de casa, possuímos um local confortável e com toda a estrutura;
Para aquele lazer no final de semana, possuímos parceria com o SESC;
Para quem está sempre buscando novos conhecimentos, contamos com parcerias nas melhores faculdades;
Ama descontinhos? oferecemos descontos nas marcas do grupo (conforme política);
Aqui você pode ser quem realmente é Prezamos pelo conforto e singularidade.
Day after de aniversário, será um dia todinho de folga para você aproveitar como quiser;
Total Pass para você que gosta de cuidar da sua saúde, nada melhor que parceria com as melhores academias.
Nossa História
Quem Somos
Somos movimento, criatividade e história. A Inbrands nasceu em 2008 com um propósito claro: construir um ecossistema de marcas que inspiram pessoas e transformam a moda em experiência.
Reunimos em nosso portfólio nomes que atravessam gerações e estilos como Ellus, Richards, VR, Salinas e Tommy Hilfiger – marcas que vestem personalidade, atitude e autenticidade.
Não seguimos tendências. Criamos caminhos. Evoluímos com consistência, estratégia e muito trabalho. Somos apaixonados por construir marcas fortes e negócios sustentáveis, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento das pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.
Nosso DNA
Acreditamos que a moda vai além do vestir — ela conecta histórias, expressa identidades e cria relações verdadeiras.
Nosso propósito é inspirar pessoas através da moda e da experiência de marca, com integridade, atitude e paixão por fazer acontecer. Crescemos valorizando aquilo que nunca sai de moda: gente, essência e verdade.

title: Field Medical Advisor
description:
Our client is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company's R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.
The Opportunity:
Syneos Health is seeking two Field Medical Advisors (FMAs) to support clinical trial programs in oncology across Latin America. This recruitment requires one FMA to be a resident of Brazil and one FMA to be a resident of Argentina.
This role will be instrumental in driving the scientific excellence, clinical insight, and medical strategy supporting our oncology pipeline and marketed products. The Medical Advisor ensures scientific integrity and alignment with global and LATAM medical affairs objectives. The position will require close collaboration with cross-functional partners including clinical development, regulatory, commercial, HEOR, market access, and field medical teams.
Responsibilities:
Develop and implement the Medical Affairs strategy and tactical plans for assigned products and therapeutic areas, tailored to the local LATAM market (Argentina or Brazil).
Establish and maintain trusted scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and healthcare professionals across LATAM countries (Argentina or Brazil).
Provide medical oversight and scientific input to cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
Contribute to medical input in promotional and non-promotional materials, internal training, and advisory boards.
Plan and execute national medical meetings, symposia, and congress participation to enhance scientific visibility.
Support investigator-initiated trials and local clinical research activities in collaboration with global and regional teams.
Monitor the competitive and scientific landscape to inform internal strategy and provide actionable medical insights.
Partner with HEOR and market access to develop real-world evidence and outcomes research projects.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (local regulations in LATAM)
Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and CROs, including site selection, Site Initiation Visits, and investigator engagement
Provide scientific review to ensure medical accuracy in materials developed by cross functional teams, including non promotional content and internal scientific training.
Requirements:
Advanced scientific or medical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD) required; oncology experience strongly preferred.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related functions in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Strong understanding of oncology clinical development, evidence generation, and treatment landscape.
Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical data effectively.
Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, academic researchers, and medical societies.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills.
Fluency in Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional, and multicultural environment.
Willingness to travel nationally and internationally (up to 70%).
Preferred Education, Experience and Skills:
Prior experience supporting oncology product launches or lifecycle management activities.
Strong network within the corresponding country oncology community" (Argentina or Brazil)
Experience leading or supporting investigator-initiated or real-world evidence studies.
Knowledge of the corresponding country healthcare system, reimbursement structures, and compliance requirements (Argentina or Brazil)
Track record in publication planning, congress presentations, and scientific communications.

Responsabilidades Principais

Preparação de Bebidas: Preparar e servir bebidas, desde clássicos da coquetelaria até criações exclusivas, seguindo receitas padronizadas ou personalizando conforme a preferência do cliente.

Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber os clientes de forma simpática e atenciosa, sugerir bebidas do cardápio e garantir um serviço de qualidade, promovendo um ambiente acolhedor e de entretenimento.

Organização e Limpeza: Manter o balcão e a área de trabalho (praça) limpos e organizados antes, durante e após o expediente, garantindo a higiene e a eficiência do serviço.

Manuseio de Equipamentos: Utilizar corretamente e higienizar utensílios e equipamentos de bar, como coqueteleiras, liquidificadores, dosadores e máquinas de gelo.

Segurança e Normas: Seguir as normas de segurança alimentar e de higiene, além de verificar a idade legal dos clientes para o consumo de álcool.

Competências e Habilidades Necessárias

Habilidades Técnicas em Coquetelaria: Conhecimento profundo de receitas de drinks clássicos e contemporâneos, técnicas de preparo (como shaking, stirring, layering) e mixologia.

Comunicação e Interação Social: Excelentes habilidades interpessoais para interagir com os clientes, criar um relacionamento e entender suas necessidades, o que é crucial para a experiência do cliente.

Organização e Agilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão em horários de pico, multitarefa e manter a eficiência e a qualidade no serviço, organizando o fluxo de trabalho.

Paixão pela Profissão: Gostar do que faz, pois o ambiente de trabalho frequentemente envolve horários noturnos e um ritmo dinâmico.

Proatividade e Aprendizado Contínuo: Buscar aprimoramento constante através de cursos, workshops e aprendizado sobre novas tendências e produtos do mercado (vinhos, cervejas, destilados).

Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com outros funcionários do bar, cozinha e salão para garantir um serviço harmonioso e eficiente.

Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e executivos, organizando informações para apresentação à liderança.

Atuar de forma colaborativa e instrutiva com assuntos técnicos em conjunto com as áreas de negócios para estrutura de controles internos e/ou soluções de problemáticas de processos.

Execução do escopo de Controles Internos:
Entrevistas com os pontos focais das áreas de negócio;
Desenho do processo em formato de fluxogramas;
Estruturar e avaliar riscos e fatores de riscos em matriz em conjunto com os donos de risco;
Listar controles identificados em matriz em conjunto com os donos de controle;
Estruturar Walkthrough de Controle / Avaliação do Desenho com explicação e evidências claras;
Planejar e executar fase de teste de controle considerando solicitação e análise de evidências;
Alinhar os resultados dos testes com os donos de controle;
Apoiar a área de negócio com a criação de planos de ação referente as recomendações.
Monitorar e atualizar planos de ação de controles, sinalizando atrasos, reincidências ou fragilidades.
Apoiar a interface com Auditoria Interna e Externa, quando relacionado a escopo de Controles Internos, organizando: (i) Evidências (ii) Respostas à recomendações (iii) Follow-up de apontamentos;
Consolidar dados e informações para relatórios gerenciais, apoiando a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Apoiar o ciclo de identificação, avaliação e priorização de riscos corporativos junto aos líderes das áreas de negócio.
Apoiar em atividades referentes ao mapa de riscos corporativos, incluindo: (i) Classificação, (ii) Avaliação de impacto, probabilidade, (iii) Controles mitigadores e (iv) Planos de Ação.
Atualizar e monitorar indicadores-chave de risco (KRIs), garantindo consistência das informações.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
IT Support Technician

  • Located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday - Friday

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The IT Support Technician provides basic technical support to the Brazil business unit. This role focuses on assisting with day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting user access, and maintaining system functionality. The position works under the guidance of senior IT staff and collaborates with local teams to ensure smooth IT operations. The role reports directly to the Director of IT and maintains a functional reporting line to the Operations Manager.

Tasks:

  1. Perform basic troubleshooting with the ability to resolve common hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
  2. Provide user support by assisting with password resets, account lockouts, and VPN connectivity issues.
  3. Monitor system performance and report issues to senior IT staff and via applicable Remedy Ticket Systems.
  4. Assist with software installations and updates of standard applications under supervision.
  5. Provide inventory & setup by preparing new workstations and ensuring proper configuration.
  6. Maintain records of support requests and resolutions.
  7. Perform simple maintenance tasks like cleaning equipment and checking cables.

Skills:

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP addresses, Wi-Fi setup).
  • Ability to follow instructions and escalate complex issues.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not include supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a professional office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones. Additionally, the role may occasionally require interaction with enterprise-grade IT and infrastructure systems such as firewalls, network switches, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and both copper and fiber optic network cabling under the supervision of Senior IT staff.

Physical Demands:

This is an active, hands-on role that requires the IT Support Technician to spend a significant portion of the day standing and moving. The position may involve short bursts of physically demanding activity, such as lifting and relocating computer equipment or navigating stairs. On occasion, tasks may require working in confined or elevated spaces, including under raised computer room floors or above drop ceilings.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time role, and as such, the IT Support Technician is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Core working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours, including occasional night, weekend, and holiday work, may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and support operational needs.

Travel:

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate. Travel will mostly be within the Rio De Janeiro area visiting client and 3
rd
 party sites to service our equipment located at those sites.

Required Education and Experience

  • Certificate of Completion of Secondary Education
  • IT-related coursework, professional training, or industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience of up to 2 years in IT support, system administration, or networking (including internships or technical school experience).
  • Working proficiency in English.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

None required.

Other Duties:

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employer for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical depth, collaboration, and systems thinking shape the future of subsea developments?
Would you bring the curiosity, adaptability, and engineering mindset needed to solve complex challenges in early-phase offshore projects?
Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team
Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create subsea systems the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea products and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best
As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, where you will give support to projects and support technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects. You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams, interacting with Customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Executing System design to proposals and projects.
  • Reporting of progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Defining system layout from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as Trees, Controls, Wellhead connections, Manifolds, and Flowlines.
  • Acting or supporting the study manager with technical interface, change control, technical variations, and general delivery of the scope.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts.
  • Liaising with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are being met and ensuring they are aware of the data input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Supporting the OFE sales and commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement or invitations to tender.
  • Assisting in the preparation of proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker.

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a MSc or BSc degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Controls Engineering or equivalent as required with extensive experience in a similar role.
  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.
  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.
  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: Field architecture / Flow assurance / System Analysis / Interface Management / Requirement Management / Process engineering / Subsea Production Systems / Risers, flowlines and pipelines / Control systems / Constructability and installation.
  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Be available to travel internationally for project needs and for short term assignments.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: Projetista Estrutural Sênior
description:
A RMO é uma empresa de engenharia, consultoria marítima, vistoria e inspeção que valoriza a excelência técnica, a inovação e a flexibilidade no trabalho. Atuamos com um time dinâmico e comprometido em entregar soluções técnicas de alto desempenho para projetos navais e offshore. Estamos em busca de um Projetista Estrutural Sênior que compartilhe nossa visão e contribua ativamente para nossos projetos desafiadores. A posição é para atuação no Rio de Janeiro, em regime de tempo integral, com contrato permanente.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenvolver projetos estruturais detalhados e de alto nível técnico para aplicações navais e offshore, com foco em fabricação, montagem e instalação;
  • Elaborar, revisar e detalhar desenhos de fabricação (DF), desenhos de montagem (DM), planos estruturais e documentação técnica associada;
  • Realizar modelagem 3D e detalhamento de estruturas metálicas e equipamentos complexos, garantindo compatibilidade com os processos de fabricação.
  • Criar e manter desenhos técnicos utilizando softwares CAD (AutoCAD, SpaceClaim, Rhinoceros 3D, entre outros), assegurando conformidade com normas e especificações técnicas aplicáveis
  • Definir e detalhar materiais, componentes e métodos construtivos, garantindo atendimento aos requisitos estruturais, operacionais e de segurança do projeto;
  • Assegurar que todos os projetos estejam em conformidade com normas técnicas e regulamentações vigentes (ABNT, NBR, ISO, bem como normas e práticas da indústria naval e offshore);
  • Aplicar procedimentos internos, padrões de clientes e boas práticas de engenharia ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de engenharia, fabricação, montagem e operações durante todas as fases do projeto;
  • Realizar levantamentos e delineamentos em campo, coletando dados necessários para o desenvolvimento e ajuste dos projetos;
  • Revisar e atualizar projetos conforme necessário, incorporando alterações solicitadas por engenheiros, clientes ou decorrentes de ajustes em campo;
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto aos clientes e às equipes internas, promovendo comunicação clara, proativa e eficaz ao longo do projeto;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia naval, estrutural e mecânica, garantindo integração e compatibilidade entre disciplinas;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e de coordenação, contribuindo com soluções construtivas e melhorias no desenvolvimento dos projetos;
  • Controlar, organizar e manter atualizada a documentação técnica dos projetos, assegurando rastreabilidade e controle de revisões;
  • Executar todas as atividades em conformidade com os processos internos de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (QSMS);
  • Contribuir para soluções construtivas que otimizem prazo, custo e segurança operacional;
  • Identificar e resolver, de forma proativa, eventuais problemas técnicos durante a execução dos projetos, adotando uma abordagem prática e orientada à solução.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação técnica ou tecnológica em Desenho Técnico, Mecânica, Estruturas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em projetos estruturais aplicados à construção, modificação e reparo de estruturas navais e offshore;
  • Disponibilidade para acompanhamento de atividades em campo (porto, fábrica, estaleiro e offshore) e para realização de viagens, conforme a necessidade do projeto.
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado à identificação e solução de problemas técnicos;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos, bem como dos requisitos de Qualidade, Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (QSMS);
  • Fluência em português e conhecimento básico de inglês para comunicação oral e escrita em contexto técnico.

Qualificações Diferenciais

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na elaboração de desenhos estruturais aplicados à fabricação de estruturas metálicas, bem como à modificação e ao reparo de estruturas navais e offshore;
  • Experiência com normas aplicáveis ao setor de projetos de engenharia Naval e offshore (API, DNV, ABS, etc.) e regulamentos brasileiros aplicáveis ao setor offshore.

Benefícios e Diferenciais da RMO

  • Regime de trabalho flexível com possibilidade de "home office";
  • Ambiente colaborativo e foco no desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Participação em projetos de destaque no setor naval e offshore.

Processo Seletivo:

  • Análise Curricular, com foco na experiência em projetos navais e offshore;
  • Entrevista Técnica, avaliando a vivência prática em estruturas offshore e navais;
  • Avaliação Técnica Específica, voltada à comprovação de conhecimento em desenhos estruturais, incluindo leitura, detalhamento e solução de problemas construtivos;
  • Entrevista Comportamental, para avaliação de competências interpessoais e aderência ao ambiente industrial e offshore.

Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho. description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA – HEAD OF GROWTH

Vaga: Head of Growth

Empresa: WiteTec | Wite Group

⸻

Sobre a empresa

A WiteTec integra o Wite Group, ecossistema focado em soluções financeiras para o meio digital, atuando com produtos de alto volume transacional como pagamentos, Pix, cartão, subadquirência, recuperação de vendas e soluções orientadas a dados.

A empresa está em fase de expansão e busca crescimento previsível, sustentável e orientado a dados.

⸻

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Head of Growth para liderar a estratégia de crescimento da empresa, atuando diretamente em aquisição, ativação, retenção, monetização e expansão.

Essa função é responsável por crescimento real do negócio, conectando marketing, produto, tecnologia e comercial, com foco total em métricas, experimentação e impacto em receita.

Não é uma vaga de marketing tradicional.

É uma vaga de crescimento orientado a dados e execução.

Responsabilidades

Definir e executar a estratégia de growth da empresa.

Mapear e otimizar todo o funil de crescimento.

Planejar, executar e analisar experimentos contínuos.

Atuar fortemente com dados, métricas e análises de performance.

Identificar gargalos de crescimento e propor soluções práticas.

Trabalhar de forma integrada com marketing, produto, tecnologia e vendas.

Garantir crescimento previsível e sustentável.

Apoiar lançamentos de produtos e novas iniciativas de receita.

Criar cultura de experimentação e melhoria contínua.

⸻

Requisitos

Mentalidade analítica e orientada a dados.

Experiência prática com growth e experimentação.

Capacidade de transformar dados em decisões e ações.

Visão estratégica com forte capacidade de execução.

Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Conforto com metas agressivas e ambientes de alta performance.

⸻

Importante

Buscamos alguém que cresça negócio, não apenas canais.

Perfis excessivamente conceituais ou sem impacto mensurável não atendem à vaga.

Cada resort tem vários restaurantes e bares, tanto voltados para eventos quanto mais íntimos, que atendem à nossa oferta Premium All Inclusive. Esses espaços permitem que os hóspedes se reconectem uns com os outros e definam o ritmo de cada destaque do dia. Do buffet ao restaurante a la carte, passando pelo bar temático ou pela adega de degustação, você se encontrará em um ambiente multifacetado. Nossa oferta refinada é construída em torno de 5 pilares: criar experiências memoráveis, surpreender com uma infinidade de áreas gastronômicas conceituais, trabalhar para o bem-estar de todos (inclusive o seu), brincar com as emoções e os sentidos por meio de encenações, tudo em um ambiente divertido e descontraído.

Você será

  • Sociável, você sabe como se conectar com nossos clientes e estabelecer um relacionamento baseado na confiança

Juntar-se às nossas equipes também é uma oportunidade única de viver e trabalhar com pessoas de todas as esferas da vida, em alguns dos locais mais Instagramáveis do mundo.

Você ganhará uma experiência valiosa em seu currículo, trabalhando para uma empresa que o apoia e treina continuamente para ajudá-lo a se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmo.

Ao se tornar Hostess, você poderá aproveitar as instalações e as atividades oferecidas pelo Club Med. Se tiver vontade, você pode até subir no palco para mostrar seus talentos

Então, está pronto para se juntar a nós? Seu futuro começa aqui...

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly
Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.
As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.
About The Role
We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.
You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.
Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.
Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.
Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.
Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.
Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.
Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.
Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.
Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.
Requirements (Must-Haves)
5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels
Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs
Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)
Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)
Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale
Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights
Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Nice to Have
Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea
Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research
Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses
Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok
Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist
description:
Customer Success Onboarding Specialist

In-office in Rio de Janeiro

>>> Only resumes in english <<<

About the Project

A leading content creation & marketing platform for K-12 athletic departments, schools, and districts in the U.S., trusted by thousands of customers across all 50 states. One of the key products is interactive touchscreen displays that showcase a school's awards, records, and history.

About the Role

As a Launch Specialist, you will be the first to welcome a newly signed school or athletic department to Touch and guide them through a smooth, high-quality launch. You'll manage multiple customer accounts at different onboarding stages, collect required assets, confirm setup details, and build much of the initial Touch site yourself (pages, content, layouts) to ensure the display is accurate, visually polished, and ready for launch—then support a seamless handoff to Customer Success.

Requirements

  • Ability to effectively manage multiple customer accounts, each at different stages of the onboarding journey;

  • Growth mindset: you're a lifelong learner who's committed to continuous professional growth and development;

  • Solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership; you can identify issues and take appropriate action;

  • Hunger for a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, change is standard, and flexibility is a must;

  • Strong design sense with the ability to create clean, organized, and visually polished Touch sites;

  • Excellent English fluency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication (C1/C2 proficiency preferred);

  • Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be in-office five days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Welcome newly signed schools or athletic departments to Touch and guide customers through a smooth, high-quality launch;

  • Manage a portfolio of partners in different stages of the onboarding journey; collect required assets and confirm setup details;

  • Build much of the initial Touch site: structuring pages, organizing content, configuring layouts, and ensuring accuracy and completeness;

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve questions, remove blockers, and keep launches moving forward on schedule;

  • Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound emails, Zoom meetings, and calls; answer questions and set timelines;

  • Log all activity in Salesforce and ensure a seamless handoff to the Customer Success team after a successful launch.

We offer

  • Mentorship and career growth: Learn directly from experienced B2B SaaS leaders, with a clear path for professional development across a variety of roles in support, sales, and customer success;

  • Ownership and impact: Take responsibility for real outcomes and see your work make a difference for thousands of organizations;

  • Startup experience: Gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-growing SaaS company operates;

  • International opportunity: Work from Brazil, with a global team, selling into the U.S. market;

  • Time off includes ~13 standard, annual US holidays, 15 business days of PTO for the first year, 18 for year two, and 21 for every year after;

  • In-office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (five days per week).

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills: Proven ability to build strong relationships with technical and non-technical members of the team to solve challenging technical and business problems.

title: Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Company You'll Join


At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid. 

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they've managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners. 

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft. 

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F. 

The Problems You'll Solve 


As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client's limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You'll Have


You'll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund's back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders. 

About You


From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience. 

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Requisition Number: 19657
Contract Type: Permanent
Location(s):
Rio de Janeiro, BR,
(Senior) Network Engineer
Role Description Summary
When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like:
In what way does it contribute to the value of company?
What part of the organisation's or team's total purpose is accomplished by people in this job?
What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs?
Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES's Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES's growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance.
Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc.
Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity.
Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software.
Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices.
Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation.
Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information.
Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices.
Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
5-7 years' hands-on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware.
Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, and NX-OS, PAN-OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command-line interfaces.
Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking.
Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD-WAN)
Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi-data center environments
Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high-throughput applications.
Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy
Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus
Hands-on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis.
In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access.
Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192.
Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus
Racking various types of networks and server equipment.
Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices.
Cage cable management experience.
Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments.
Other Key Requirements / Comments
CCNP Enterprise (Cisco Certified Network Professional) OR equivalent
PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).
Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

title: Regulatory Senior Analyst
description:
The Regulatory Senior Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This position will coordinate regulatory requirements, consolidate technical documentation, assess compliance risks, support audits and inspections, and implement action plans to address findings. The role contributes directly to maintaining operational licenses, preventing non‑compliance, avoiding fines or interdictions and ensuring alignment with internal schedules, budgets and applicable Brazilian authorities' requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Define the scope and deadlines for deliverables that sustain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, observing production schedules and budgets.
  • Support the definition of responsibilities and resources to achieve regulatory compliance efficiently, observing the BWE organization charts and budgets.
  • Incorporate lessons learned to BWE, set action plans to prevent or address audit findings, notifications, and conditions to operate imposed by the Authorities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations to ensure awareness of regulatory requirements, build compliance, and fulfill BWE schedules.
  • Ensure that compliance-related tasks are executed efficiently, facilitating licenses and approvals, as well as preventing fines and interdictions.
  • Consolidate engineering document lists, including all tech safety studies that are required to grant and sustain licenses and approvals needed to operate.
  • Assess the content of engineering, tech safety, and other management system documents to provide proper support and guidance to achieve compliance.
  • Follow up on specific discussions and execution wherever assigned to ensure proper incorporation of regulatory compliance requirements and related risk.
  • Support activities to implement BWE strategy and scope for internal regulatory compliance self-assessment, inspections, and audits to prevent project schedule delays, interdictions and fines.
  • Track, manage, and ensure proper closure and documentation of regulatory-related action items.
  • Perform and/or guide inspections and audits of BWE facilities to assess and ensure proper compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements.
  • Organize and coordinate internal preparations for regulatory audits.
  • Flag to the Regulatory and Institutional Affairs Manager always when a potential critical non-conformance is identified or delays in regulatory compliance may delay schedules or not follow the original budgets.
  • Support all other regulatory-related activities when required.

Requirements


Education

  • Engineering degree.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of experience with regulatory requirements applied to offshore platforms.
  • Experience fulfilling requirements for ANP shipyard audits.
  • Experience responding to ANP conditions to operate.
  • Knowledge of Class, Flag, and Navy requirements.

Knowledge

  • Good understanding and knowledge of Offshore systems
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (oral and written).

title: Production Operator
description:
The Production Operator will be responsible for safely operating and monitoring the facility's process and utility systems to ensure stable and efficient offshore production. This includes operating separation, compression, dehydration, seawater injection and utility systems, preparing equipment for maintenance, performing process analyses, supporting emergency response actions, and ensuring compliance with operational and safety procedures. The role contributes to maintaining safe operations, equipment integrity, and consistent production performance.

Responsibilities

  • Start/stop and operate oil and produced gas separation plants, gas compressors, glycol dehydration, HPU systems, produced water systems and utilities.
  • Understand the safe operating limits of these systems and parameter control.
  • Start / stop and operate water cooling, coarse / fine filtration, deaeration and seawater injection systems. Understand the safe operating limits of these systems.
  • Philosophy of isolations, Permit to Work, Operational, Fire and Gas, and COSHH Task Evaluation. Basic knowledge of cause and effect.
  • Knowledge of the actions and duties of emergency event response as required in abnormal / emergency situations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of actions required to minimize commercial loss while maintaining safe operation. Prepare / isolate equipment or systems for intrusive maintenance.
  • Responsible for conservation and preservation as well as first line maintenance on production system (valves and equipment).
  • Assist and stand-by when Electrical / Instrumentation and mechanical technicians are working on process systems in order to keep the system safe to perform work.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline cleaning activities using pigging technology.
  • Communicate effectively with co-workers and communicate any deficiencies to the Control Room Operator and Production Supervisor. Control, operate and optimize daily chemical dosing rates associated with the process system.
  • General organization and maintenance duties in work area.
  • Perform dew point analysis, TOG analysis, BSW analysis, pH analysis
  • Perform external readings according to the frequency defined by the PSUPT, verify the values with the Control Room Operator and report any deviations found to the supervisor, defining corrective measures.
  • To generate clear and simple reports aligned with the task.
  • Other duties that are related to the function, as instructed, and requested by the Production Supervisor Maintain up-to-date certification applied to his/her function and medical certificates Participate in company training, as defined.
  • Ensure compliance with BW procedures as applied to your position, including the work permit system. Comply with all emergency tasks assigned to your role in the emergency response plan, when applicable.
  • Required to be fully familiar with and comply with the Company, Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures assigned to your title / position.
  • Anticipate and realize any unsafe condition and ensure that the correct actions are taken as per procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers.
Requirements

Education

  • Technical or equivalent qualification from the country of origin.

Experience

  • Experience in offshore production operations or similar environments.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge aligned with the company's Competence Assurance Assessment requirements.
  • Familiarity with production systems, utilities, chemical dosing, pigging operations, and laboratory/process analyses (dew point, TOG, BSW, pH).
  • Understanding of isolation philosophy, Permit to Work procedures, Fire & Gas principles, emergency response actions, and operational safety requirements.

Sobre a BigDataCorp
A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.
Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo.

Ao assumir o cargo de Estrategista de Conteúdo Pleno na Afya, seu objetivo principal será desenvolver a estratégia de conteúdo do produto/projeto em que atua, em parceria com o time de Produto e editores médicos, e alinhada à estratégia da Afya, inclusive estabelecendo e acompanhando indicadores.

Você atuará na área de Estratégia de Conteúdodentro da diretoria de Conteúdoe fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, UX e Tecnologia.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA:

  • Atuar como responsável central pela curadoria de conteúdo do produto/projeto;
  • Definir, implementar e acompanhar a estratégia de conteúdo em parceria com: Times de Produto, Marketing e demais stakeholders;
  • Desenvolver a estratégia de conteúdo alinhada à estratégia da Afya;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com editores médicos e o time de Produto;
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da estratégia de conteúdo;
  • Garantir consistência, relevância e qualidade do conteúdo entregue;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino Superior Completo em áreas como Comunicação Social, Letras ou áreas afim;
  • Experiência na ideação, planejamento e acompanhamento de resultados de projetos de conteúdo para produtos digitais;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência no uso de dados para tomada de decisão e acompanhamento de resultados;
  • Experiência prévia com conteúdo médico ou de outras áreas da saúde;
  • Conhecimentos sobre conceitos de Gestão de Produto Digital;
  • Conhecimento sobre metodologias ágeis;

Informações adicionais

GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.


Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);

UP na remuneração:

  • PLR;
  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.

Família, Saúde e Bem-estar:

  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Academia de idiomas (AIA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

Diferencial para Professor Médico:

  • Assinatura premium do Afya iClinic e Afya Whitebook.

O MAIOR ECOSSISTEMA DE EDUCAÇÃO E SOLUÇÕES PARA PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia. #VemSerAfya

  • Experiência com planejamento e atualização do Projeto Pedagógico do Curso (PPC), legislação educacional e regulatório;
  • Vivência anterior em Coordenação, Docência ou no segmento de Educação.

Como será seu dia a dia como educador ou educadora:

  • Apoiar o Coordenador de Curso na implantação dos cursos e propor eventuais alterações, conforme tendências do mercado, evitando desinteresse pelo curso e consequente evasão de aluno.

  • Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos cursos, serviços e informações geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade;

    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.

  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
